children: Equity LifeStyle Properties released an investor presentation on Sept. 10, 2026 highlighting portfolio metrics, 2026 guidance and a 5.3% dividend increase to $2.17 per share.
Posted investor presentation on website Sept. 10, 2026 outlining operations, strategy and financials for investors.
Board approved 2026 annual dividend of $2.17 per share, up 5.3% from $2.06 in 2025; emphasizes shareholder returns.
Provided 2026 guidance: net income per share $2.05–$2.15; FFO per share $3.15–$3.25; normalized FFO $3.13–$3.23.
Portfolio snapshot as of June 30, 2026: 453 properties, 173,559 sites across 35 states and 1 Canadian province; $16.3B enterprise value.
Highlighted balance sheet strength: 4.1% weighted average interest rate, ~7 years avg maturity, Debt/EV 20.5% and Total Debt/Adj. EBITDAre 4.4x.
